description.text: The third XY set, released on 13 August 2014 with 113 cards: 111 and two secret rares, Mega Heracross-EX and Mega Lucario-EX. It centers on Lucario and Fighting Pokémon such as Machamp, Hariyama and Tyrantrum, with Fighting Stadium and Strong Energy to back them, and its Pokémon-EX include Dragonite-EX and Hawlucha-EX.

description.text: The 1st Place League Challenge copy of Shelmet: a crosshatch holofoil print stamped with the Pokémon League logo and its placing, the prize for first place. League Challenges were small tournaments that a store running a Pokémon League could hold once a month; each came with a sealed kit of twelve of these cards, three for each place, for the top four players in each age division. The crosshatch pattern marks the early League Challenge promos, from the first events in 2013 until BREAKthrough in 2015.
